premises: Atomically dispersed Pd on high-entropy fluorite oxide (HEFO) can be synthesized.
Pd1@HEFO shows CO oxidation onset at ~80 °C, much lower than Pd@CeO2 (~223 °C).
The activity enhancement is due to more reactive lattice oxygen in HEFO near Pd.
High-entropy oxide supports confer superior stability against sintering/deactivation.
The synthesis and performance are achievable under lean-burn, hydrothermal conditions.
